results.title: Audition 109
results.overview: A young man from Busan moves to Seoul to become an actor, only to find himself struggling to make ends meet. Lines get tangled, his Seoul accent gets worse, and even love doesn't go his way.

results.title: Hating
results.overview: Ondřej Šálek’s time-lapse documentary captures an escalating street battle between pro-Russian activists at a petition stall in Prague’s Klárov district and a group of liberal-minded citizens who have decided to take justice into their own hands. Footage from live streams and first-hand observations reveal verbal and physical altercations and the growing radicalisation of both camps. This unsettling account of the forms taken by civil resistance in a sharply polarised society does not adopt the perspective of either side. An impartial observation of the actions and counter-actions shows how easily a sense of threat and the desire to belong to a particular community can escalate into aggression.

results.title: Sukhamano Sukhamann
results.overview: Theo, an ambulance driver stigmatized by his town, begins seeing visions of deceased people he transports. His troubled mind, shaped by childhood loss, creates these apparitions as emotional substitutes for connection.

results.title: Der Geier – Blut und Zweifel
results.overview: A seasonal worker is found murdered with a crossbow in the mountains of Bad Gastein. For former witness protection agent Lukas Geier, the case brings back a dark past. Racing against Detective Franziska Conte, he must uncover whether his former client is being framed or if he saved the wrong man.

results.title: Orange Crush & JCW: Superpower Slam 2026
results.overview: Orange Crush presents Superpower Slam 2026 is a professional wrestling charity show benefitting neurodivergent individuals involving JCW and GCW and pro wrestlers from ROH/AEW it took place on 2.1.26

results.title: Che Guevara: The Last Companions
results.overview: After the triumph of the Cuban Revolution in 1959, three guerrilla fighters followed Che Guevara in his attempt to carry the uprising beyond the island. In 1967, after their final battle in Bolivia and Che’s execution, these shadow warriors embarked on an extraordinary 2,400 km journey across Bolivia, pursued by 4,000 soldiers and navigating remote terrain in a bid to stay alive. Sixty years later, Che’s last surviving comrades recount this untold story of endurance and loyalty, in which individual destinies were shaped by the larger geopolitical currents of the Cold War. Blending rare archive footage, animation and exclusive interviews, the film brings a forgotten chapter of history into the present.

results.title: Peaking: Psychedelics and the Pursuit of Happiness
results.original_title: Peaking: Psychedelics and the Pursuit of Happiness
results.overview: “Peaking: Psychedelics and the Pursuit of Happiness” is a feature documentary that explores all the major psychedelics, not just by explaining how they work medicinally, but by taking viewers inside dosing rooms for extremely rare looks at the remarkable power, emotion, and speed of psychedelic healing in action: from pro athletes repairing brain damage from concussions, to combat veterans finding relief from suicidal despair, to a woman breaking free from opioid addiction, to survivors of the Nova Music Festival massacre who say being on psychedelics during the attack shielded them from developing mental trauma.

results.title: Ghostwatch: The Night That Terrified Britain
results.original_title: Ghostwatch: The Night That Terrified Britain
results.overview: Taking a look back at the 1992 BBC spoof supernatural documentary, when 11 million viewers were taken in by a fake investigation, presented by Michael Parkinson and Sarah Greene, into paranormal activity at a family home in Northolt, North-West London

results.title: In This Darkness I See You
results.overview: Strange and life-threatening events in a construction site create tension between the Syrian workers and the Lebanese villagers. Tarek, one of the workers, becomes convinced that the site is haunted.

results.title: Love is Love
results.overview: Enrique Juarez is an up-and-coming Mexican Telenovela actor on the verge of becoming a leading man, that has to hide his true self in order to achieve stardom.

results.title: ADEM
results.overview: Haunted by someone else's memories a construction worker in Germany, searches for a way to send them back to Kosovo.

results.title: Комнатное растение
results.overview: Parents ask their daughter to pretend to be her dead sister for her grandmother, who refuses to believe her younger sister is dead. This request becomes a test for the entire family.

results.title: Vanishing Goats
results.overview: Nothing is going right in Élise’s life: stuck in a toxic romantic relationship, she finds herself thrust into the role of director following the sudden death of the famous Groutchov, for whom she had been an assistant. A strange symptom—panic disorder—overwhelms her. Élise tries to put on a brave face, but her relationship with the world is completely transformed. Could this be an opportunity for her to look at life differently?

results.title: Zainab Johnson: Toxically Optimistic
results.overview: Zainab Johnson has a gun revelation, a Tesla crisis and an unshakable belief that she can find the upside in everything in this sharp stand-up hour.

results.title: BuenosAires
results.overview: On Pernambuco's Zona da Mata, Northeastern of Brazil, the municipality of Buenos Aires bares the same name of Argentina's capital. A Spanish teacher introduces the characters and places of the city, a landscape of social contrasts with influences from different cultures. Despite no sight of Porteños there, some locals insist on the coincidence by many ways, and develop an emotional attachment to the neighboring country. Soccer games, a hometown team's parade, and the arrival of an argentine strengthen such connections during the 2022 World Cup.

results.title: Orange Justice
results.overview: Two bumbling but well-meaning NYPD cops on suspension, Murph and Taylor, are tasked with escorting a disinterested Gen Alpha teen, Lacey, to meet her estranged father in Canada.
